output.reply: Thanks for the suggestion! Having Lumen's dark mode automatically follow your system setting makes a lot of sense, especially if you're switching manually every evening. I've passed this along to our product team as a feature request. We can't promise a timeline, but feedback like yours helps us decide what to build next. Thanks for helping make Lumen better!

Hi there! Thanks for reaching out, and great idea to back up before you travel. You can export your notes from Lumen's settings. Look for the export or data/backup option, choose Markdown as the format, and download the file to your device. If you don't see a Markdown option or run into any trouble with the export, just reply here and let us know which device and app version you're using, and we'll help you get your backup sorted. Safe travels!

Hi Maria, thank you for letting us know, and sorry about the duplicate charge. We'll look into the two $9.99 Lumen Plus charges dated the 3rd. Once we confirm the duplicate, we'll refund it to your original payment method. Refunds usually take 5–10 business days to show on your statement. If you can, please reply with the email address on your Lumen account and the last four digits of the card so we can find the transactions quickly. Best regards, Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the trouble. It sounds like a regression in how Lumen web handles pasted tables from Google Sheets on Chrome 131, especially since it worked last week. I've passed this to our engineering team to investigate. To help us reproduce it, could you share a sample of the table you're pasting (or a screenshot of the before/after) and confirm whether the same happens in an incognito window with extensions disabled? In the meantime, a possible workaround is to paste the table into a new Lumen table block, or paste as plain text and use Lumen's 'Convert to table' option. We'll keep you updated as soon as we have a fix.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry you're locked out of your account. Because the password reset link goes to your old work address, we'll need to verify your identity before we can update the email on your account. Please reply from your new email address with the old email address on the account and any details that help confirm ownership, such as the approximate date you signed up, your plan type, the last four digits of the card on file, or the titles of a few recent notes. Once we've verified you, we'll switch the account to your new address and send a fresh reset link there. If your company manages your Lumen account through a team or workspace plan, your workspace admin may also be able to update the email for you directly.

Hi there, thanks for letting us know, and sorry about the timing with your exam on Friday. We understand how important it is to get to your lecture slides. It sounds like the latest iOS update is causing the app to crash when opening notes with attached PDFs. We've passed this to our engineering team as a high priority. In the meantime, your notes and PDFs are still safely stored in your account, and you can reach them right now by signing in at the Lumen web app from any browser, or from the Lumen app on another device. To help us fix this faster, could you send us your iOS version, your device model, and the Lumen app version (Settings > About)? It would also help if you could tell us whether every note with a PDF crashes or only some. We'll update you as soon as a fix is available. Good luck on Friday!

I'm very sorry about this charge, and I completely understand your frustration. Being billed $120 after you cancelled in March shouldn't have happened. Please reply with your cancellation confirmation email (or forward it to us) along with the email address on your Lumen account. As soon as we receive it, we'll verify the cancellation and process a full refund of the $120 as a priority. We'll also confirm that your subscription is fully closed so this doesn't happen again. We'll keep you updated every step of the way and will send you confirmation once the refund has been issued.

Hi there, I'm so sorry you and your team are locked out right before your presentation. We're treating this as urgent and have escalated it to our engineering team right away, even though the status page isn't showing an incident yet. To help us pinpoint the issue quickly, could you reply with: your workspace name, roughly how many team members are affected, whether you're using desktop, web, or mobile, and your general location/network (e.g., office network or VPN)? In the meantime, a few things that may get you working again: 1) Try the web app at a different browser or in a private/incognito window. 2) Try switching networks (e.g., a mobile hotspot), since a firewall, VPN, or DNS issue can cause 'Cannot reach server.' 3) If you use the desktop or mobile app, notes you've opened recently may still be available offline, so you can copy or export what you need for the presentation. We'll update you as soon as we know more. Thank you for your patience, and good luck with your presentation.

Hi there! Thanks for reaching out. To share a notebook in Lumen, open the notebook, click the Share button (or right-click the notebook in the sidebar and choose Share), then enter the email addresses of the people you'd like to invite. You can set each person's permission to view or edit before sending the invite. You can also generate a shareable link if you prefer. Let us know if you run into any trouble!

Thanks for the detailed feedback, and we're glad Lumen is part of your team's daily workflow! Seeing who edited a note and when, including a version history with editor names, is a great suggestion, and we understand how frustrating it is when you can't tell who removed content. I've logged this as a feature request on behalf of your 12-person team and noted that you'd be willing to pay for it. That helps our product team prioritize. We'll keep you posted on any updates. In the meantime, let us know if there's anything else we can help with.

We're sorry this happened, and thank you for reporting it so quickly. Please take these steps right away: 1) Change your Lumen password to a strong, unique one. If you use the same password anywhere else, change it there too. 2) In Settings > Security, sign out of all other sessions and turn on two-factor authentication. 3) Open the sharing settings for the two affected notebooks and remove the address you don't recognize. 4) Secure the email account linked to Lumen, since password resets go there. Our security team has flagged your account for review. We'll look into the suspicious login and check for any other changes. Please reply with the approximate time of the login alert and the address the notebooks were shared with. If you're locked out at any point, let us know and we'll help you regain access.

Hi there! You can update the display name shown next to your comments by going to Settings > Profile, editing the Display Name field, and clicking Save. The new name should appear on your comments shortly. If you still see your old nickname, try refreshing the app or signing out and back in. Let us know if it still doesn't update and we'll be happy to help!

I can't promise a timeline, but feedback like yours directly shapes what we prioritize, and we'll let you know if any of these ship. Thanks for helping make Lumen better!

Hi there, sorry about the hassle. We know it's frustrating when a menu you rely on moves after an update. To turn off the weekly summary emails, open Settings (now reached from your profile picture or avatar in the top-right corner), go to Notifications (sometimes labeled Email Preferences), and switch off "Weekly summary." The change saves automatically. If you can't find the option, reply with the device and app version you're using and we'll walk you through it. You can also use the unsubscribe link at the bottom of any weekly summary email. Thanks for your patience, and we'll pass along your feedback about the Settings layout to the team.

Hi there, thank you for the kind words, and for being with Lumen for two years! It's very sensible to check before reorganizing several hundred notes. Here's how to proceed safely:

1. Before making changes, export a full backup of your notebooks so you have a restore point no matter what.
2. Test on a small sample first: create two throwaway notebooks with a few linked notes (including comments and a few edits), then move a note and merge the notebooks. You can confirm that links, comments and edit history behave as you expect without risking your research data.

I'm also confirming the exact behavior of internal links when notes are moved, and what happens to comments and edit history when notebooks are merged, with our product team. I'll follow up with a definitive answer so you can plan your reorganization with confidence. We'll also flag that the help center should cover this clearly.

Best of luck with the research, and thanks again for using Lumen!

Best regards,
Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for reporting both of these issues, and sorry for the trouble. We've logged them for our desktop team: (1) the app freezing for a few seconds when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes, and (2) Ctrl+B sometimes inserting a literal 'b' instead of applying bold. To help us reproduce them, could you share your Lumen version (Help > About), your Windows version, and your keyboard layout/language? For the Ctrl+B issue, it would also help to know whether it happens more often right after opening a note or while typing quickly. If you can, please also send logs via Help > Send Diagnostics. In the meantime, splitting very large notebooks may reduce the freezes, and using the Bold button in the toolbar should work reliably. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry about the broken images after your Evernote import. This usually happens when attachments don't come through in the export file. Lumen doesn't have a setting to re-link attachments after import, so re-importing is the best fix. Here's how: 1) In Evernote, export your notebooks as .enex files and make sure attachments are included. 2) In Lumen, delete or move the affected imported notes so you don't end up with duplicates. 3) Run the import again using the new .enex file. If the images still appear broken, please reply with the approximate number of affected notes and a sample note title, and we'll look into it further.

Please reply from the email address on your Lumen account with: (1) your account username or email, (2) the approximate date you created the account, (3) your plan type and, if you're on a paid plan, the last 4 digits of the card on file or a recent invoice number, and (4) a few note titles or folder names you remember. I've marked your ticket urgent because of your deadline, and we'll process it as quickly as we can once we receive these details. After you're back in, please set up two-factor again and store your new recovery codes somewhere safe. Thanks for your patience. The Lumen Support Team

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and we're sorry to see you go. When you delete your Lumen account, we remove your profile, all of your notes, notebooks, attachments and settings, and any active subscription is cancelled. To get started, go to Settings > Account > Delete Account and confirm. Before you do, you may want to export your notes via Settings > Export, because deletion is permanent and can't be undone. I'll also confirm the exact timeline for removing your data from our active systems and backups so you have accurate details. If you'd prefer, I can start the deletion for you once you confirm from the email address on your account. Let me know if you have any other questions.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Happy to help you get a reusable standup template set up before your end-of-day deadline. Here's a reliable approach: create a note with your standup structure (for example, sections for Yesterday, Today and Blockers), give it a clear name like "TEMPLATE – Weekly Standup," and place it in a shared notebook or folder your team can access. Each week, team members can duplicate that note and fill in their updates, leaving the original untouched. If you let us know which plan you're on and whether you're using the web, desktop or mobile app, we can confirm whether a dedicated template option is available to you and walk you through it step by step. If templates aren't available today, we'd be glad to pass this along as a feature request. Let us know if you have any other questions!

Sorry about that, it's annoying to see our own name flagged as a typo! Here's a quick fix: right-click the underlined word 'Lumen' and choose 'Add to Dictionary' (or 'Learn Spelling' on Mac). The spellchecker should stop flagging it in all your notes. If you'd rather turn spellcheck off entirely, go to Settings > Editor and toggle off 'Check spelling while typing'. I've also passed this along to our team so Lumen can recognize its own name by default in the future. Let us know if it keeps happening!

Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out! Keeping work and personal notes separate is a great idea. Lumen currently signs in one account at a time on a device. To switch, go to Settings > Account > Sign Out, then sign in with your other account. Your notes stay safely synced in the cloud, so nothing is lost when you switch.

If you'd like to use both at once, you can stay signed in to one account in the mobile app and use the other through Lumen on the web in your phone's browser.

If having multiple accounts signed in at the same time would be useful to you, let us know and we'll pass it along to our product team as a feature request.

Best regards,
Lumen Support

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! To turn on offline mode, open Lumen's Settings, go to the Offline/Sync section and enable offline access. Lumen will then download your notes so you can work without a connection, and any changes sync automatically once you're back online. Shared notebooks: whether notebooks your teammates shared with you are available offline can depend on your permissions and app version. To confirm, try enabling offline access for that notebook directly from its menu. If the option isn't there, let us know your app version and platform and we'll confirm for you. Plus plan storage: I don't want to give you an inaccurate number, so I'm checking the current Plus storage allowance and will follow up shortly. You can also see your current usage and plan limits under Settings > Account. Let us know if you have any other questions!
